definitions.observed: Present, absent, partial, broken, or otherwise directly evidenced by a named census. Observation does not establish intended completeness.
definitions.owner_decision: The census cannot choose the inventory, threshold, policy, obligation, or retirement disposition. Operator ratification is required.
definitions.required: Candidate requirement for Host Operational Portrait v1. Because this manifest has authority none, required does not become binding until operator ratification.
definitions.retire: Candidate permission to retire a deployed capability or implementation shape only after an explicit operator decision and its stated retirement condition. This classification authorizes no removal.

rules: A capability may carry more than one classification because current observation and candidate cutover disposition are independent axes.
An observed configured set is not a complete required inventory unless an operator ratifies that closure.
No owner_decision row may be silently converted to required or retire.
No retire row authorizes a service stop, file removal, data deletion, or authority switch.
The manifest status and authority apply to every required and retire classification.

clean_install_obligations: A clean supported host can identify and verify every installation artifact without a sibling checkout or developer target directory.
The operator selects an explicit host or application role and reviews its target inventory before collection begins.
Configuration and compatibility are validated before mutable state is initialized or upgraded.
Provider or helper qualification, admission, and self-diagnosis fail visibly before service enablement when evidence identity or privilege is incomplete.
The first supported host-role result is a useful bounded operational portrait rather than only a protocol conformance specimen.
Install, enablement, first start, upgrade, rollback, removal, and retained-state behavior are explicit and independently testable.
Parallel qualification uses isolated configuration, state, runtime, service, listener, and backup identities and does not mutate Classic.
These are outcome obligations and do not select a package manager, repository layout, process count, or installer implementation.

acquisition_coverage_states.current: Required evidence arrived within its bound and was admitted for the exact subject, scope, and vantage.
acquisition_coverage_states.intentionally_excluded: An operator-ratified scope declaration excludes the subject or dimension. Silence alone cannot create this state.
acquisition_coverage_states.missing: Evidence was expected under an explicit inventory but did not arrive.
acquisition_coverage_states.not_configured: No target or provider was declared. This is not evidence of healthy absence.
acquisition_coverage_states.partial: Some required subjects, dimensions, fields, or vantages are current while others are unavailable or unaccounted for.
acquisition_coverage_states.refused: Acquisition, admission, projection, or evaluation explicitly refused the evidence and retained the refusal boundary.
acquisition_coverage_states.stale: Previously accepted evidence exists but is older than its bound.
acquisition_coverage_states.unsupported: The qualified provider or profile explicitly cannot testify about this substrate or dimension.

condition_states.condition_present: Current sufficient evidence supports the bounded condition.
condition_states.explicitly_absent: Current sufficient evidence under closed declared coverage supports bounded absence.
condition_states.unknown: Coverage or evidence is insufficient, inapplicable, contradictory, or not evaluated; no condition conclusion is available.

evidence_relation_states.agree: Distinct observations are compatible within their declared scopes.
evidence_relation_states.contradictory: Observations disagree within the bounded diagnostic; the relation must remain explicit for later Nightshift/operator composition.
evidence_relation_states.independence_unknown: Different surfaces exist, but failure-domain or vantage independence is not established.
evidence_relation_states.shared_failure_domain: Observations share a host, disk, network, proxy, clock, provider, or other declared failure domain.

rules: Acquisition coverage and domain condition are separate axes.
Collector success with an empty payload establishes neither inventory completeness nor explicitly absent condition.
Service or container liveness does not substitute for application progression.
HTTP 2xx does not substitute for a semantic application verdict.
Classic NQ Monitor loop liveness does not mean the diagnosed subject is healthy.
Missing series or an unconfigured collector remains unknown unless independent closed-world coverage supports a stronger conclusion.

diagnostic_product_frame.bounded_implementation_slice: A witness/provider acquisition path, profile, detector, diagnostic read/export path, Nightshift recurrence/campaign, derived monitor or alert, or frontend view can contribute to the operator journey but is not the whole ownership stack.
diagnostic_product_frame.continuous_operation: The primary NQ object is one scoped and bounded diagnostic. Repeating diagnostics under Nightshift recurrence and expiry is what monitoring is built on.
diagnostic_product_frame.host_operational_portrait_v1: Host Operational Portrait v1 is the candidate minimum complete operational-posture contract over each ratified subject, scope, vantage, operator task, diagnostic profile, application overlay, self-diagnosis, typed read/export, recurrence, expiry, alerting, retention, backup, and clean-install obligation. Nightshift composes the portrait from bounded NQ results; NQ does not produce the whole portrait.
diagnostic_product_frame.nq_recursive_fabric: NQ-to-NQ recursion carries exact bounded dispositions or refusals as testimony for the same exact parent diagnostic question without laundering subject, evidence frontier, or limitations. It is not open-ended operational composition.
diagnostic_product_frame.operator_analogy: The operator compares this distinction to MRI only as an analogy for acquisition feeding one scoped diagnostic. The analogy introduces no medical terminology, medical claim, or medical semantics into NQ.

roles.authority_and_execution: Humans or AG own separately governed authorization; Docket owns execution through that separately governed operation boundary.
roles.frontend: Maude or another frontend renders stable typed NQ diagnostic exports and Nightshift operational output without minting diagnostic or operational authority.
roles.monitoring_alerting_portraits_reporting: Monitoring, alerting, portraits, reporting, and proposed automation are built from repeated exact diagnostics and Nightshift current posture; they are not upstream semantic inputs to NQ.
roles.nightshift_and_operators: Nightshift owns recurrence, expiry, campaigns, multi-diagnostic current posture, and operational proposals without rewriting NQ testimony; humans or agents provide separately identified interpretation or proposals without gaining NQ or action authority.
roles.notification: Nightshift or explicit operator policy creates exact alert intent for an identified diagnostic or operational state transition; candidate nq-notify owns only delivery attempts and attempt/result receipts and selects no implementation, schema, transport, or delivery law.
roles.nq: NQ selects exact required evidence, checks custody, admissibility, and coverage, evaluates one scoped and bounded subject/question, and returns an exact typed diagnostic disposition or refusal without granting remediation authority.
roles.nq_monitor: nq-monitor, if retained, inspects one diagnostic's evidence, custody, coverage, evaluation, disposition, and refusal; it is not the whole-estate console.
roles.profiles: Profiles are compiled, identified diagnostic protocols that state the question, evidence projection, coverage, bounds, limitations, and evaluator semantics.
roles.witnesses_and_providers: Witnesses and providers are admitted acquisition modalities with exact subject, scope, vantage, identity, capability, and custody boundaries.

diagnostic_product_frame.routine_monitoring_and_surveillance: Routine monitoring is a downstream use of repeated bounded diagnostics under Nightshift recurrence, applicability, and expiry. Witnesses/providers perform acquisition; monitoring is not an upstream semantic substrate for NQ.
diagnostic_product_frame.semantic_core: NQ's semantic core is an evidence-bound diagnostic answering one declared, scoped, bounded question about one diagnosed subject while retaining what cannot be concluded.

diagnostic_read_export_and_operational_p: NQ provides a stable typed machine-facing diagnostic read/export contract rather than owning successor dashboard UX.
The NQ export exposes observation currency and expected-versus-observed coverage separately from domain condition.
The NQ export preserves current, partial, stale, refused, missing, unsupported, intentionally excluded, and not configured without flattening them into green or red.
The NQ export preserves condition present, explicitly absent, and unknown as a separate axis.
The NQ export carries exact disposition or refusal identity, subject, scope, vantage, source or provider, profile, evaluator, evidence time, freshness, limitations, and safe next checks.
nq-monitor, if retained, is an inspector/disposition explorer for one diagnostic and not the whole-estate console.

Nightshift binds the exact NQ diagnostic inputs it composes, applies identified recurrence and expiry, coordinates campaigns, and emits stable typed current-posture output without rewriting NQ testimony.
The Nightshift enterprise surface exposes configured profiles and each profile's last-result time, applicability, coverage, expiry state, and contribution to current posture.
Maude or another frontend consumes the typed NQ and Nightshift contracts, leads with supported urgent facts, and does not create diagnostic truth, operational authority, or delivery custody.
The contracts support core operator tasks without private-table SQL and remain read-only with respect to collection and remediation.
The observed Classic NQ Monitor remains a functional-equivalence input but does not select an NQ-owned successor dashboard.
This candidate does not select Maude, another web or terminal frontend, transport, port, authentication mechanism, or deployment topology.

retention_backup_obligations: Operator ratification selects evidence, evaluation, disposition, refusal, delivery-receipt, and application-overlay retention periods; this candidate does not choose durations.
Configured disk budgets are either enforced under an explicit contract or exposed as unenforced declarations with current size and runway.
SQLite main, WAL, checkpoint, and backup state remain separately visible.
Backup creates an identified artifact and restore qualification proves semantic reopening before the artifact is relied upon.
Classic history is frozen and retained under an explicit archive/access policy and is not imported as current NQ-NG state.
Removal or package purge does not silently destroy evidence, admissions, backups, or receipts.
Parallel qualification and rollback preserve an explicit split observation interval rather than merging histories.
self_diagnosis_obligations: Exact NQ core build, static profile cohort, evaluator, detector suite, protocol, and store identities are inspectable.
Nightshift recurrence/campaign state exposes last requested diagnostic, last admitted completion, next expected run, applicability, expiry, lateness, overlap, and refusal.
The declared expected provider, helper, profile, subject, scope, and vantage inventory is compared with actual current evidence.
Helper absence, privilege denial, admission drift, executable drift, malformed output, timeout, and stale evidence remain distinct.
Store schema, integrity-opening result, WAL state, disk use, retention activity, backup state, and write refusal are visible.

Typed NQ diagnostic read/export and inspector availability, Nightshift operational-output compatibility, and alert-intent/delivery coverage are visible without being folded into the diagnosed subject's condition.
NQ liveness cannot produce an all-clear when active findings or missing required evidence exist.
